specification.title: Osnap Near Point Intersection
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không tạo picking engine thứ hai; GUI toggle Matrix thuộc 03.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Osnap Near Point Intersection” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
acceptance_tests_manual: Manual gate M02: run OpenMatrix9 UI; perform “Osnap Near Point Intersection”; observe preview/feedback and commit/cancel behavior.
A visible failure/warning must be shown for unsupported input; the command must never silently do nothing.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

proposed_fixture.algorithm_and_coverage: Giao chính xác trong plane rồi map world; near solve t; typed no-solution
proposed_fixture.tolerance_policy: Use document absolute tolerance of M01; do not guess at source pin; pixel threshold calibrated for DPR.

runtime_implementation.scope: Near is a clamped segment solve with a finite t; Intersection is an exact 3D segment/segment solve over distinct roots, skipping parallel pairs.
remaining: Manual M02-UI review pending; no human sign-off is claimed.

standalone_verification_2026_10_22.acceptance: Crossing segments return (5,0); parallel segments return no intersection; a point beyond a segment clamps to its endpoint with t=1.

standalone_verification_2026_11_18.scope: A loaded SDK Point query returns the exact source and releases queued NURBS extraction from a superseded End query while the worker permit is held.

isolated_intersection_among_overlaps_202.scope: Line viewport fixtures report overlap-only cases and commit isolated 3D intersections with both source identities. One fixture refuses a screen crossing between sources at different depths. A second verifies that a Line and cubic NURBS overlap at Z=2 cannot suppress a Line/Line crossing at Z=0 at the same screen location.

intersection_touch_and_visibility_2026_1.scope: Synchronous Intersection resolves a placed collinear endpoint contact. Native viewport and SDK Intersection resolve a line crossing in Wireframe and refuse it behind a mesh in Shaded.

apparent_intersection_shaded_visibility_.scope: A Shaded mesh between Z=0 and Z=8 leaves the upper apparent witness usable before Project maps the point to Z=0. A mesh at Z=10 suppresses the viewport marker and leaves the one-shot armed, and the SDK returns a completed miss.

shared_instance_intersection_2026_11_18.scope: Synchronous Intersection reports the placed crossing and two source member paths under one root. A loaded SDK query also preserves both member identities in Wireframe and respects occlusion in Shaded.

installed_apparent_intersection_default_.scope: The installed Rhino 5 native Osnap menu, profile setting and defaults use the same apparent-intersection field. The factory enables it and the shipped Matrix90 scheme has no override. Viewport acceptance depth, tie, true/apparent ranking, and Project still require Matrix9 runtime evidence.

apparent_intersection_perspective_refere.scope: The installed host's apparent Intersection check uses the camera-to-source rays on the Perspective near plane. An off-axis fixture distinguishes both original source points after World Top Project and exercises unequal source parameter and screen chord fraction.

perspective_segment_source_parameter_202.scope: Near resolves both sources of the off-axis Perspective fixture. The remaining source retains its point and fraction after near-plane clipping. Line-based snaps and ordinary edge picking share a camera interpolation.

opt_in_apparent_intersection_segments_20.scope: The opt-in viewport fallback retains both visible segment sources and resolves the selected world point before Project. Curved apparent sources and Matrix9 multi-pair ordering remain open.

apparent_intersection_curves_2026_11_18.scope: The default-feature worker handles circular arcs and positive-weight rational NURBS in the apparent fallback. The Perspective replay verifies original source parameters, clipping, both source IDs and Project applied after picking a source.

apparent_intersection_cylinder_rim_2026_.scope: The viewport worker resolves an apparent crossing of an OCCT cylinder rim and a Line in Perspective. Wireframe and Shaded retain the two source IDs and the rim point before Project. Four Line commits cover both Project settings and individual Undo.

single_cubic_nurbs_intersection_2026_11_.scope: The viewport resolves a true self-crossing of one cubic NURBS and retains the source in both identity fields. The replay evaluates the issued fraction on the original curve and checks the Line commit with each Project setting and one Undo.

trim_hole_intersection_reopen_2026_11_19.scope: A Line intersects only the inner boundary of a reopened, rotated and nonuniformly scaled planar NURBS surface. Wireframe and Shaded retain both source identities and the verified World point before Project. Each display mode checks both Project states and one Undo per Line.

apparent_int_partly_visible_nurbs_2026_1.scope: The Perspective worker splits mixed-depth positive-weight NURBS and restores the original source fraction. The scene test covers a split endpoint, reversed traversal and near-plane rejection. The Windows egui replay verifies two source IDs and Line commits with Project on and off.

polycurve_intersection_parent_parameter_.scope: The default worker maps Line and arc constituent witnesses to the connected nested Polycurve's original normalized traversal. The replay covers reversal, one shared source ID, true and apparent crossings, and Project applied to the accepted Line point.

scene_intersection_source_parameters_202.scope: Synchronous supported pairs report parameters on the selected original curve. Verified examples cover nested reversed Polycurve, degree-one rational NURBS with clipped active domain, a Line–circle tangency and a Polycurve arc crossing a circle. The fixture checks original point evaluation and both source IDs.

nested_apparent_intersection_viewport_20.scope: Viewport Apparent Int preserves two distinct member paths under the same root and leaf. The rotated and nonuniformly scaled source reevaluates at the reported parameter. Wireframe and Shaded each retain the unprojected witness and commit the correct Line with Project off or on. One Undo restores the block and definitions.

sdk_apparent_intersection_2026_11_18.scope: The optional SDK query kind binds two source member paths. Consuming the issued hit applies Project to the selected source witness and allows one staged Point commit.

imported_apparent_int_repeatability_2026.scope: Five fresh imports of the same version-50 3DM retain exact source geometry but yield two different World heights for an apparent-option Int tie. Authored creation stamps are retained in the OM9 control. Matrix9 ordering and the proposed import tie rule remain pending.

apparent_intersection_creation_order_202.scope: At equal screen distance, two creation orders of the same three Lines select apparent Z=8 and true Z=2, respectively. A strictly closer true candidate can replace a prior hit. The replay covers Undo/Redo and .om9 reopen. Direct Matrix9 viewport observation remains pending.

apparent_int_project_windows_2026_11_19.scope: The same Looking Down pixel on two Lines shows Apparent Int and commits World (-8,6,8) with Project off and (-8,6,0) with Project on. The native Windows run used the O-Snap context menu and preserved both sources through Undo.

apparent_int_project_review_build_2026_1.scope: The current alternate Windows OM9 build accepted (-8,6,8) and (-8,6,0) at the same Looking Down pointer position, with Project off and on respectively. Both showed the apparent marker and added one Line Undo. Undo restored both source objects.

matrix9_fixture_native_viewport_2026_11_.scope: The separate Matrix90 viewport displayed the matching two-Line archive and native CMD reported a successful read. Automated CMD and Int clicks showed no state change. The native preference and both Project coordinate results remain pending.

matrix9_native_cmd_replay_2026_11_18.scope: The Matrix9 replay creates the source geometry at two known heights using native Line input. The elevated window prevented automated input, and the archive workflow produced a Rhino RDK version warning. A Matrix9 observer still needs to capture the point cue and accepted World coordinates with Project off and on.

snaps_menu_audit_2026_11_17.qualification: Historical technical_scope_complete is limited to its recorded fixtures; it is not current whole-menu acceptance
